scientific_integrity: An explicit global two-dimensional potential, strict Hessian estimate, boundary-degree count and corner descent prove the claimed all-parameter phase-locking threshold comparison. Direct finite computations are supplementary, not certificates of the infinite quantifiers. Literature priority is provisional because the motivating arXiv full text could not be inspected.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three positively reciprocally coupled sinusoidal oscillators with frequency sum zero; no phase lag, inertia, higher-node graphs, global attraction, or classification of nonprincipal stable states. Independent audit and historical priority check not performed.
title: Braess-free completion of a three-oscillator Kuramoto path, with sharp equality cases
